scope: Prospective fixture-only executor approval binding; not active runtime/CLI/loop wiring, real execution, provider, chemistry, evaluation, replication, training, paper, release, or SOTA evidence.

supported: The current ApprovalRequest lacks a CLI-schema digest field.

qualified: The live-derived Click schema is used only as a fixture input.
unresolved: Durable executor-side consumption, real user-approval integration, provider behavior, chemistry outcomes, and all P3-P6 evidence surfaces.
